config.notes: Course pages www.newcastle.edu.au/degrees/<slug>. International view (5 Oct 13:02): the key-facts panel is filled by script, so /degrees/ pages are read through Firecrawl (page_view render, wait 6 s; the "#intl-view" fragment only marks pages already read this way, the site ignores it). The rendered panel prints the domestic block (UAC code, selection rank) and the international block ("CRICOS Code <code>, Program Code <n> Indicative fee 1 AUD <fee>"; footnote: indicative annual fee for a full year full-time load of 80 units). fee = the AUD figure after the course's own CRICOS code ({code}); it equals the approved 2026 international fee schedule (no year printed next to it, so no fee year is recorded). intakes = term names in the rendered "Start dates (<location>)" list (and the "Note: Semester/Trimester 1 commences on ..." line) mapped with the 2027 academic calendar (https://www.newcastle.edu.au/our-uni/academic-calendar; PDF https://www.newcastle.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0005/1137173/Academic-Calendar-2027.pdf): Semester 1 / Trimester 1 = February, Trimester 2 = May, Midyear = June, Semester 2 / Trimester 3 = August. CAUTION: the rendered page states "This criteria is based on a Full-time Domestic student" and the start-date list covers every location including Online, so it is NOT the international start list (Master of Clinical Epidemiology lists Semester 1 and 2; the international meta UON.Degree.StartDate.International says Semester 1 only). The international start terms are in <meta name="UON.Degree.StartDate.International">, which the worker cannot read yet; intakes are not admitted. IELTS from "IELTS overall minimum - X". Delivery: the page prints study locations (e.g. "Online Newcastle City"), no delivery mode; not read. handbook.newcastle.edu.au is robots-disallowed; honours-year, research (PhD/MPhil), pathway and exchange programmes have no /degrees/ page.
